review_comments.body: Adding this new test file is not worth it. [connection_unit_test.go](https://github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go/blob/main/connection_unit_test.go#L756) already covers related tests. The new test belongs to `connection_unit_test.go`.

`tlsConfigFromURI` only reads the URI and local files. Calling it before [dialer("tcp", addr)](https://github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go/blob/main/connection.go#L373) gives a fast local error with no socket opened, so the added `conn.Close()` isn't needed.
After moving `tlsConfigFromURI` before `dialer("tcp", addr)`, this test needs a re-write. No socket will be opened, hence nothing to close.

Thanks @suchitd, good catch. Moved `tlsConfigFromURI` before `dialer("tcp", addr)`, so a bad cacertfile/certfile/keyfile now fails before any socket is opened and the extra `conn.Close()` is gone. The standalone `connection_tls_test.go` is removed; the test now lives in `connection_unit_test.go` and asserts the dialer is never called when TLS config creation fails.

(This follow-up was prepared with the assistance of Claude Code.)
